topic: How the Moon runs the tides (two bulges, spring and neap tides, and the Moon slowly drifting away)
title: How the Moon Moves the Ocean (and Why There Are Two Tides a Day)
description:
Why does the sea rise twice a day? The Moon pulls the ocean into two bulges, the Sun joins in, and some bays turn the tide into a giant. We bust the one-bulge myth, explain spring and neap tides, the Bay of Fundy, and how tides are slowly pushing the Moon away. #tides #moon #science

Up next: What if the Moon disappeared?
